modalContent.title: SplitLeh — Scan. Review. Split fairly.
modalContent.description: A mobile-first Progressive Web App for splitting bills without the hassle. Scan a receipt with your camera — OCR runs entirely on-device — then review and edit line items, assign them to people in your group, and get a per-person breakdown instantly. Fully static: no backend, no login, no server. Clean flow: Scan → Review → Split → Results.

modalContent.title: SG Invoice
modalContent.description: A Singapore-focused invoice web app for small and home-based businesses. Create standard invoices, tax invoices, simplified tax invoices, receipts, and credit notes with GST calculations aligned to IRAS guidance. Features business profiles, PayNow QR codes, line-item discounts, dark/light theme, live print/PDF preview, and local-only storage with JSON export/import. Runs entirely in the browser — deployed to GitHub Pages.

modalContent.title: BouncerBot
modalContent.description: An email validation tool that answers whether an email looks like it belongs to a real human or a bot — beyond basic @ checks. Uses AI (Ollama) plus traditional validation to evaluate domain legitimacy, username patterns, and name–email coherence. Three modes: AI-only, Non-AI only, and Hybrid (recommended). Supports single-email analysis and batch CSV processing for whitelist/blacklist decisions. Built with FastAPI, Next.js, TypeScript, and local Ollama. For local use only.

modalContent.title: WiFi QR Generator
modalContent.description: Generate a QR code for your WiFi so guests can print or share the QR code as an image. Enter network name, password, and security type; download as PNG or print (full page with credentials). Deployed to GitHub Pages.

modalContent.title: Real-Time Incident Response System
modalContent.description: An automated incident response system built with Amazon Connect that triggers escalation calls when alerts are received. The system uses AWS Lambda to orchestrate outbound calls, with automatic escalation to secondary contacts if the first contact does not respond. Features include call status monitoring, DynamoDB logging, and SNS integration for alert management.

modalContent.title: Endless Jumper Game
modalContent.description: A fun endless runner game built in just 2 hours using Amazon Q AI assistant. Features include power-ups, increasing difficulty, and smooth gameplay mechanics. The game demonstrates rapid prototyping and AI-assisted development.

modalContent.title: ApsaraChat Live: Real-time monitoring of COVID-19 with DataV
modalContent.description: A webinar where I was invited to speak about utilising Alibaba Cloud's DataV for real-time data visualisation and monitoring.

modalContent.title: Slack Bot
modalContent.description: A custom Slack bot built to automate workspace tasks and streamline team workflows using Python, Slack API, and AWS services.

modalContent.title: Webcam Test
modalContent.description: A static webpage designed for testing your webcam before going live, ensuring you look great before presenting yourself to the world.

modalContent.title: Personal Portfolio
modalContent.description: A dynamic personal portfolio website built with TypeScript, Vite, and modern web technologies. Features include interactive timeline, project showcase, and dynamic content loading from JSON configuration.

modalContent.title: ShareShed: Library of Things
modalContent.description: A Brisbane-based 'Library of Things' platform enabling members to borrow items with annual membership. Built as part of DECO3801 course using Django, replacing third-party system limitations with a responsive, role-based web application. Features include membership management, catalogue browsing, lending/returns, operating hours configuration, and admin dashboard.

modalContent.title: INFS3208/INFS7208 Cloud Computing Project
modalContent.description: University of Queensland cloud computing project implementing a scalable web application using Cassandra NoSQL database, Spark Job Server for data processing, and Docker + Nginx for containerised deployment. Awarded Project Excellence Award (Best Project Demo) by Prof Xue Li in Oct 2018.
